tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor bsngo bskang ba rab zab don tshang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsa turmu kha ye/ rgyud sde'i nges gsang stobs 'phrog dbang / /mchod phyir nas nag rjen phye dang / /khrag chang mar dang khungs ldan gyi/ /bdud rtsi ril phye sbyar ba las/ /gtor ma snying gzugs phyogs bzhi ru/ /yum bzhi'i bshos bu de 'dra bzhi/ /dbus gtor phyed zin mtha' bskor du/ /mtheb kyu rgyun du brgya rtsa yis/ /bskor dpangs gtor ma'i sum cha tsham/ /sha mar rgyan ldan smug rtsis byug /mda' dar nag pos brgyan de'i g.yas/ /khrag phud g.yon du chang phud dang / /mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ /nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs shing / /spos bdug sbyor ba'i rim pa'o/ /dngos gzhi bde kyai phur 'jigs sogs/ /yi dam bdag bskyed sngon 'gro bas/ /mchod gtor/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me'i khrod/ /thod skam sgyed pu gsum gyi steng / /dum gsum thod pa phyi dkar zhing / /nang dmar yangs shing rgya che bar/ /lcags kyu sgron me ye shes lnga/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag rus tshogs bcas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka dang / /bya khyung phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum sogs brjod byin brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi dang / /dgra bgegs ro yi gdan steng du/ /hūm̐ yig nag lnga yongs gyur las/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa/ /dbus nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhing / /steng zhal dud mdog thams cad kyang / /dmar zlum spyan ldan mche gtsigs shing / /ljags 'dril smar smin dbu skra rnams/ /kham nag gyen 'bar thod skam lngas/ /dbu rgyan thod rlon sbrul rus sogs/ /'jigs pa'i rgyan dang tshangs skud bcings/

/dril bu g.yer ga'i gsil sgra 'byin/ /stag sham can gyi phyag g.yas pa/ /gri gug g.yon na thod khrag 'dzin/ /g.yas 'og ral gri mdung gang rung / /g.yon 'og thod phreng 'phyar stabs can/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa mchan du thogs/ /zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas/ /gyad kyi dor stabs can gyi g.yas/ /g.yung mo nag mo g.yon phyogs su/ /gtum mo ljang khu mdun phyogs su/ /srin mo dmar mo rgyab phyogs su/ /siṅga li ser bzhi ka'ang / /khro mo gcer bu sgyu ma yi/ /ga shal can la gri thod 'dzin/ /mtha' bskor bka' nyan dmag dpung bcas/ /me 'bar dbus bzhugs gnas gsum du/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ges mtshan/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rgya bod me 'bar gnas bzhi sogs/ /gar bzhugs gnas nas byon par gyur/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam ye gnyis/ /dbyer med ngang du ro gcig gyur/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ /gos kyi dbyibs su bcas byas la/ /oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra sa mā ya sma ra si/ sa mā ya ma ti kra ma tha sa mā ya rakṣantu/ stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos ltar/ /dam tshig rjes su dran mdzod la/ /rnam bzhi'i las sogs myur sgrubs shig /zhes pas dam gzhag rdor thal mthar/ se gol bcas sngags 'di brjod/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍombhi nī/ tsaṇḍa lī/ rakkha sī siṅga li/ de wī sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ urga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ bā liṃ di swāhā/ lan gsum sogs kyis dbul/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod mtheb srin g.yon pas dbul/ stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas kyis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'jig rten skyongs/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung zhing skyongs/ /mdor na ci bsam kun 'grub mdzod/

/gal te bzlas pa bya 'dod na/ /zhal bzhi'i yum bzhi'i thugs kar ni/ /hūm̐ yig dkar las bdud rtsi babs/ /bdag la thim pas 'khon sbyangs bsam/ /he ru ka yi yig brgya bzla/ /bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /skyabs kun byin bsdus rang thim bsam/ /bdag bskyed sngags bzlas mgo mnan la/ /slar yang 'od rtser phyi nang gsang / /mchod sprin spros pas mchod nas kyang / /'phrin las gang bcol mdzad mos nas/ /oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍāoṃ bhi nī/ tsaṇḍa li/ rakkha sī/ siṅga lī de wī hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas mthar gong bzhin phyi nang mchod pa dang / 'dod pa gsol ba gtor bsngo'o/ /gal te bskang ba bya 'dod na/ gnyan gyi gsung nyid byin che bas/ /de bzhin spyan 'dren bskangs byas nas/ /'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis stsal ba'i/ /bstod dang 'dod gsol 'di bzhin no/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing / /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gzhon nu'i lus can bgegs 'joms khyod la bstod/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang / /siṅga la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar ser ljang nag khros pa'i zhal/ /gri gug thod 'dzin bstod par bgyi/ /mdor na gang dang gang bcol ba/ /de dang de yi las rnams la/ /btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /bdag la rjes su brtse bar mdzod/ /zhing skyong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan pa'i gtor ma dang / /sman raka phud dang dzam bu ti/ /sha khrag la sogs 'di bzhes la/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las kun mdzod cig /ces brjod gtor ma khang thog tu/ /nyin mo spos dang mtshan mo ni/ /dpal 'bar bcas shing phud chang dang / /lhan cig dbul la rjes kyi char/ /yig brgya lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes/ /ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyid pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/

/'di yi bris 'bur sogs yod na/ /de la gong du bskyed byas nas/ /brtan bzhugs 'di brjod bzhugs par bsam/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes dang rten la me tog gtor/ /dmigs rten med na 'khor bcas rnams/ /rang la thim bsam gnas gsum sogs/ /srung ba bdag bskyed gang yin bzhin/ /bsngo smon shis brjod ci rigs bsam/ /yang na 'di ltar brjod par bya/ /dge 'dis 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /gnas skabs mthar smon kun 'grub par/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung gis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /chos srung nor lhas rnam kun du/ /shis pa'i me tog char phab nas/ /dus gsum bkra shis dge legs shog /ces 'di rgyal tshab bka' drin can/ /de mo dam pa'i zhabs 'gyur ba/ /mgron gnyer bka' bcur mtshan thogs pa'i/ /bzhed pa bskang phyir kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor bsngo bskang ba rab zab don tshang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
